THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / OCTOBER 2026
WINTER
052
STUDY 165
Cable-Knit Red Sweater & Denim Mermaid
Skirt
Rights check
Source: 25053.jpg
Cozy, festive, sweet
WORKING NOTES
- The red cable knit and denim mermaid skirt are the
signature pairing.
- Keep the beret and bow for a playful, winter finish.
Try this: Keep the beret and bow for a playful winter finish.
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with soft, pale
auburn hair and a white knit beret with a
flower accent stands against a soft beige
backdrop. She wears a chunky red
cable-knit sweater with an off-shoulder
drop and a black bow tie at one
shoulder. A dark denim mermaid skirt
with a frayed asymmetric hem and a
patch sits beneath, with a red plaid scarf
draped over one arm. Brown chunky
loafers and white socks complete the
look. Her expression is calm and direct.
Soft, even studio light. Palette of
crimson, indigo denim, and cream. Cozy
and festive, in the style of a winter
knitwear catalog.
